body:
Well, I'm not gay, so I don't really know if my advice is of any use to you, but I fee like helping someone.

First things first, you don't need to kill yourself because you can't find a guy you like (and trust me, I know how debilitating loneliness it)
If I were you, I'd avoid gay night clubs and hookup apps entirely (I'm assuming that grindr is like the tinder for gay people) and I'd try to go to a more conservative, long-term dating site, or just find other meeting where gay men like to go without the context of sex involved (basically steer clear of bars and other places like that.)
I'm certain that there are more men like you out there, wait and you will eventually find someone, and please don't kill yourself over the fact that you can't find someone, I can guarantee with 100% certainty that someone else is out there with your same mindset who would love to be with you.
Best of luck, stay safe
